title: slow living vlog 🌱☁️ long-form content to calm your mind, no talking, peaceful daily life
description:
hello, and welcome to vlog 62!
this week, i am back with a slower paced, calm vlog (that ended up being my longest video yet!)
with all of the overwhelming content and fast paced living in this world, i've been inspired to slow down and get back in touch with each moment. as i've been working on this, i wanted to create a video for you all to do the same! a space where we can all relax, set aside some quiet time, and live in the moment. so, i hope you'll enjoy these days with me as i do some cleaning, unpacking, cooking and making drinks, reading, planning with my favorite stationery, etc.
may we all remember to slow down, enjoy the little things, and see rest as a productive and important part of life too. thank you always for being here, and don't forget to take care of yourselves! grab a snack, drink some water, and do something you love
until next time ~
